headline: Approved raising the hawker and peddler permit fee to $150 a year; tabled the wildfire protection plan until October 20.
summary: Public comment covered the September 8 primary, House Bill 1331, and the wildfire plan. Members adopted an ordinance raising the hawker and peddler permit fee from $50 to $150 per year. They tabled the 2026 Community Wildfire Protection Plan until October 20, 2026.
decisions: Sealed the minutes of the non-public session indefinitely under RSA 91A:3 II (c), 7-0-0.
Approved the consent agenda: minutes of September 1, 2026, Resolution #2026-052, and Resolution #2026-054, 7-0-0.
Appointed Linda Comrie to the Conservation Commission for a term to expire March 31, 2028, 7-0-0.
Adopted Ordinance #2026-003, amending Chapter 119 and raising the hawker and peddler permit fee to $150 per year, 7-0-0.
Tabled Resolution #2026-050, accepting the 2026 Community Wildfire Protection Plan, until October 20, 7-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-051, directing the Tax Collector not to execute certain tax deeds, 7-0-0.
Adopted Resolution #2026-053, authorizing an interagency agreement with Rockingham County for a $13,338 Justice Assistance Grant, 7-0-0.
